values.name: default replay duration

values.name: custom replay range
values.source: Original renderer-CustomGameHotkeyContext.js!ce @0x8BF; src/mechanics.rs replay_seconds

values.name: replay presets
values.source: Original renderer-CustomGameHotkeyContext.js!_ @0x847; src/mechanics.rs REPLAY_PRESETS

values.name: default frame rate
values.source: Original main.min.js!bo @0x141318 overrides recorder fallback 30 via SetupAppSettings RVA 0x9e4e4; src/mechanics.rs DEFAULT_FPS

values.name: frame rate choices
values.source: Original renderer-constants.5.js; src/main.rs FPS_CHOICES; minimum 15 and arbitrary saved FPS are local policy

values.name: capture display
values.value: primary display by default, any attached display selectable; optionally the display the detected game runs on
values.source: Local choice: src/capture.rs displays (DXGI) and choose_display; src/games.rs window_monitor and src/main.rs capture_display

values.name: capture dimensions
values.value: height-based aspect scaling to the quality preset, no upscale, truncation and even floor
values.source: MedalEncoder.exe ScaleResolution RVA 0x4EB0C, GetResolution RVA 0x4EBA0, CalculateOutputResolution RVA 0x2290C; src/encoding.rs capture_size; local two-pixel minimum

values.name: quality presets
values.value: 720p 15 Mbit/s (default), 1080p 25, 1440p 40, native
values.source: Original desktop default 1280×720 at 15 Mbit/s (main.min.js!bo); 1080p/1440p/native and their bitrates are local choices derived from ResolutionHandler..cctor tuples RVA 0x4ec30; src/settings.rs Quality

values.name: capture cursor
values.source: Original main.min.js!bo ShowCursor=false; src/settings.rs show_cursor default, configurable

values.name: record system audio
values.source: Local WASAPI loopback of the default render endpoint: src/audio.rs; original records desktop audio through its own engine

values.name: record microphone
values.source: Recorder fallback MicEnabled=false in Settings..cctor RVA 0x28568; src/settings.rs microphone default, configurable

values.name: capture target bitrate
values.value: preset Mbit/s × 1,000,000; multiplied by output/configured pixel-area ratio only above 1
values.source: MedalEncoder.exe CreateConfig RVA 0x231D0; src/encoding.rs CaptureEncoding::for_output

values.name: capture rate control
values.value: ABR/VBR; max bitrate 2x; VBV 2x; B-frames 0; GOP=floor(fps*4/10)
values.source: MedalEncoder.exe CreateConfig RVA 0x231D0 and Config.get_AverageBitrateMaxRatio RVA 0x282F8 fallback 2; src/capture.rs encoder_args

values.name: video encoder
values.value: GPU when available (NVENC, AMF, QSV), else libx264; H.264 yuv420p
values.source: Recorder fallback GPU encoding in Settings..cctor RVA 0x28568; src/capture.rs probe_capabilities and select_encoder

values.name: screen capture backend
values.value: Desktop Duplication (ddagrab) with GDI fallback
values.source: Local choice: src/capture.rs strategies

values.name: save replay shortcut
values.value: F8
values.source: Original main.min.js!bo clip;length=30 short_press; src/settings.rs hotkey_replay default, configurable with modifiers

values.name: record automatically on launch
values.source: Local manual-start policy with optional record_on_launch setting; original RecordingEnabled default differs

values.name: replay export length
values.value: min(available_seconds, requested_seconds), cut at the keyframe at or before the requested start
values.source: MedalEncoder.exe ClipOutput.SaveClip RVA 0x51A1C; scope.dll exportable_duration 0x180003021; src/recorder.rs save_replay and export_tail

values.name: replay buffer
values.value: bounded ring of 5-second MPEG-TS segments, old segments deleted beyond replay length plus two segments
values.source: Local adaptation of the original memory/disk ring buffers: src/recorder.rs poll and expired_segments

values.name: replay continuity
values.value: continuous; saving a clip never interrupts the recording
values.source: src/recorder.rs save_replay concatenates segments while FFmpeg keeps recording

values.name: clip cooldown
values.source: Config.get_ClipCooldownSeconds RVA 0x27e04 fallback 1; src/recorder.rs CLIP_COOLDOWN

values.name: full session recording
values.source: Recorder fallback FullSessionMode=false in Settings..cctor RVA 0x28568; src/settings.rs keep_full_session default, configurable

values.name: editor minimum selection
values.unit: seconds, or whole source if shorter
values.source: Original renderer-rulerStep.js!Ot @0x5CBC and fi.#ve @0x72D0; src/mechanics.rs, main.rs trim action and ui/app.js

values.name: trim export
values.value: precise re-encode (libx264 CRF 20) or fast stream copy from the previous keyframe; original kept
values.source: Local adaptation: src/recorder.rs trim_clip; original main.min.js!lfe @0x147A37 stream-copies

values.name: import behavior
values.value: copy without overwriting existing clips
values.source: Local choice: src/library.rs import_clip

values.name: delete behavior
values.value: move to the recycle bin
values.source: Local choice: src/platform.rs recycle (SHFileOperationW FOF_ALLOWUNDO)

values.name: automatic recording on game start
values.source: Local feature inspired by the original's game detection: src/games.rs GameWatcher, ~90 built-in executables plus user entries; original uses its own game database, not reproduced

values.name: game detection method
values.value: visible top-level windows mapped to their executable (EnumWindows + QueryFullProcessImageNameW)
values.source: Local choice: src/games.rs visible_apps; no hooking or injection

values.name: clip file name
values.value: <Spielname oder Clip> YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS.mp4
values.source: Local choice: src/recorder.rs clip_path and sanitize_prefix

values.name: in-game notification
values.value: click-through banner top right of the recorded display for 2.6 s
values.source: Local adaptation: src/overlay.rs layered window; the original draws an in-process overlay, which is not reproduced

values.name: clip confirmation sound
values.source: Local choice: src/overlay.rs generated two-note chime via PlaySoundW

values.name: exact clip length
values.value: optional re-encode of the saved clip to the requested duration
values.source: Keyframe cut follows ClipOutput.SaveClip RVA 0x51A1C bounds; the optional exact re-encode is a local addition: src/recorder.rs trim_to_exact_length

values.name: microphone as separate track
values.source: Local choice: src/capture.rs build_command maps the mixed track plus the microphone input; original mixes into one track

values.name: audio device changes
values.value: follows the default endpoint while recording and reopens a lost device
values.source: Local robustness: src/audio.rs current_default_id and open_stream

values.name: cloud uploads, public publishing, advertisements
values.source: Requested local-only scope: src/main.rs local IPC/media; ui/index.html CSP

values.name: audio loudness per source
values.value: 0–200 % for system sound and microphone; 100 % adds no filter
values.source: Local addition: src/capture.rs audio_mapping (volume filter, asplit for the separate microphone track); the original mixes at device level

values.name: second replay length
values.value: optional second clip length with its own shortcut; the ring keeps the longer of the two
values.source: Local addition: src/settings.rs replay_seconds_long and buffer_seconds, src/main.rs HOTKEY_REPLAY_LONG

values.name: free space reserve
values.value: 5 GB by default; the recording stops below it, checked before the start and every ten seconds
values.source: Local policy: src/recorder.rs start and poll, src/platform.rs free_bytes (GetDiskFreeSpaceExW)

values.name: clip folder limit
values.value: off by default; above the limit the oldest clips are deleted permanently, never the newest one
values.source: Local policy: src/library.rs over_limit and src/main.rs enforce_storage_limit

values.name: capture restart after a failure
values.value: up to three restarts in five minutes; skipped while full session mode keeps the segments
values.source: Local robustness: src/recorder.rs PollIssue and src/main.rs handle_issue

values.name: marked moments
values.value: a shortcut remembers the spot; the clip is cut later with a configurable lead and tail (20 s / 10 s by default)
values.source: Local addition: src/main.rs Marker and marker_job, src/recorder.rs save_marker and export_span

values.name: marked moment availability
values.value: savable while the whole window sits in finished segments; the ring keeps lead plus tail as well
values.source: Local policy: src/recorder.rs buffered_span, src/settings.rs buffer_seconds

values.name: marks inside a saved clip
values.value: positions of marked moments are kept with the clip in the media index, shown on the editor timeline, and carried over when the clip is renamed or trimmed
values.source: Local addition: src/main.rs marker_offsets and remember_markers, src/recorder.rs trim_clip start reporting, src/library.rs IndexEntry::markers, ui/app.js renderMarks
